title: CombatCurves
description: Tunable combat scaling coefficients applied at runtime by MonsterFactory and by the encounter-sim design tool. Single source of truth so design-time simulations match live-game scaling.

hpPerDanger.description: HP multiplier added per danger-level point. Final HP = base * (1 + danger * hpPerDanger).

powerPerDanger.description: Ability BasePower multiplier added per danger-level point. Final power = base * (1 + danger * powerPerDanger).

speedPerDanger.description: Flat speed bonus added per danger-level point. Final speed = base + danger * speedPerDanger.

bossHpMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to a boss-flagged monster's already-scaled HP (danger 10 primary).

bossSpeedBonus.description: Flat speed bonus added on top of normal scaling for boss-flagged monsters.
